title: micranthes stellaris var. prolifera
intro: Micranthes stellaris var. prolifera, commonly known as Alpine cinquefoil, is a plant species native to the mountainous regions of Europe and Asia. It has been traditionally used for its health benefits, which include aiding in the treatment of digestive issues, such as diarrhea and constipation, due to its antispasmodic properties. The therapeutic actions of Alpine cinquefoil include its ability to relieve pain, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antimicrobial properties, making it useful in wound healing and skin conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
